sanity_expectations: All four states remain real and finite over t in [0,12] with the chosen parameters.
p(t) should stay within [0,1] and increase initially from p(0)=0.5 because the initial realized gain is positive.
selection_coefficient(t) should decrease monotonically from 1.0 because its RHS is strictly negative for positive selection_coefficient.
attenuation_occupancy(t) should rise initially since occupancy_buildup_rate*p(0)=0.6 exceeds occupancy_relaxation_rate*attenuation_occupancy(0)=0.35.

delayed_burden(t) should increase from 0 after an initial lag because occupancy is positive and burden_buildup_rate*attenuation_occupancy/(burden_half_saturation+attenuation_occupancy) initially exceeds burden relaxation.

The realized attenuation acting on dp/dt should be weak near t=0 because delayed_burden(0)=0, then strengthen later as delayed_burden accumulates, producing extra late slowdown beyond what selection decay alone would cause.

Because asymmetry_strength>0, the frequency kernel multiplying selection_coefficient is asymmetric in p rather than exactly p*(1-p); if trajectories sample interior p values, the strongest instantaneous gain need not occur exactly at p=0.5.

rationale: Preserving the supplied ODE-system contract exactly, the dataset should sample only time and integrate the 4-state system with one shared biologically admissible parameter set. The chosen values keep all rates nonnegative, avoid singularities, and place the system away from both the parent-recovery limits and deep immediate saturation. With p(0)=0.5 and selection_coefficient(0)=1, allele gain is initially substantial; selection then decays on an observable timescale because selection_decay_rate is comparable to the experiment duration and selection_capacity is moderate. Occupancy is generated fast enough from p to rise early, but its direct state is no longer in the p-equation; instead delayed_burden is built from occupancy through a saturating law and relaxes more slowly than occupancy, creating the intended two-timescale memory effect. attenuation_capacity=2 keeps delayed_burden/attenuation_capacity in an order-1 regime over reachable trajectories, so the quadratic attenuation term matters without crushing dp/dt to near zero throughout. asymmetry_strength=1.6 and asymmetry_threshold=0.3 make the competitor-dependent amplification visible over the interior p range while remaining finite and positive. The selected burden parameters expose the generation-5 contrast specifically: early in the run attenuation is weak because delayed_burden starts at 0 even though attenuation_occupancy already starts at 1, whereas later the accumulated burden suppresses p more strongly after occupancy history has had time to act. Weak/inactive note: because this spec preserves the inherited initial condition delayed_burden(0)=0, the burden effect is absent exactly at t=0 and must emerge dynamically; this is a real limitation of the inherited contract, not repaired here.
